descriptions.zh: 一名细心的通讯官识别出了这些模糊的信号，在伽马射线的干扰下，它们从黑洞抵达这里时已经几乎不可识别——这信号虽然微弱，但明显不是自然产生的。这个现象引起了科学家们对其的更多兴趣。
descriptions.en: An alert communications officer has identified what appears to be a faint signal, almost lost in the gamma-ray flashes from the black hole here - faint, but unmistakably artificial. This raises intriguing possibilities for our scientists.

label.zh: 确认

descriptions.en: An alert communications officer has identified what appears to be a faint signal, almost lost in the gamma-ray flashes from the black hole here - faint, but unmistakably artificial. This raises intriguing possibilities for our scientists.

label.zh: 确认

descriptions.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]汇报称该信号破译起来出乎意料的简单……但是他们的团队花了相当长的时间来证实这不是一个恶作剧。它的段落反复重复，与[Root.Owner.GetAdj]语言有一定的关联——听上去是某种诗歌。它们重复着短语§H引力即欲望§!以及§H时间即视野§!。信号中暗藏了一个黑洞附近的坐标，并在结尾以§G署名§!的形式特别献给了我们的科学专员——这名科学专员客观的确认了这个信号在他们出生之前就已经被发射进入宇宙空间里面了。事实上，这个信号可能比我们文明还要古老。
descriptions.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the signal was unexpectedly easy to decipher... but their team has spent considerable time confirming that it's not a hoax. It is a repeating, half-coherent message in the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] language - something like a poem. It repeats the phrases §HGRAVITY IS DESIRE§! and §HTIME IS SIGHT§!. It encodes co-ordinates near the black hole. And it ends with a dedication §Gby name§! to the Science Officer - who adds dispassionately that they have confirmed that the signal has been radiating into interstellar space since before their birth. In fact, the signal may predate our civilization.

label.zh: 令人着迷！派遣船只前去那个坐标。
label.en: Fascinating! Send the vessel to those co-ordinates.

label.zh: 这要么是恶作剧，要么是圈套。记录好之后就别管了。
label.en: This is a trick, or a trap. Log it and move on.

tooltips.zh: 分析信号时发掘的技术将运用于物理学研究。
tooltips.en: The techniques we developed to analyze the Signal will have some applications in Physics research.

descriptions.zh:
当[Root.GetName]接近信号所附带的坐标时，他的报告表明周围的空间开始出现涟漪，古怪的引力透镜现象此起彼伏——这些是丰富且重要的数据流。紧接着，通讯信号开始变得失真，我们能做的只有尽可能地排查原因。

然而，科学专员[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]歇斯底里的声音在船只处于越来越诡异的条件下，为整个事件更加蒙上一层恐怖的阴影。船只触发了遇险呼救。[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]大叫到 “虫子！”——或者，也有可能，§H那个虫子§!！然后所有通信全部终止了。[Root.GetName]的痕迹彻底消失了——没有进一步的传输信号，没有残骸，坐标附近的空间平静的如同静谧黑夜的大海一样。但是他们传回的数据极大的推动了我们物理学研究。也许他们死得其所。
descriptions.en:
As the [Root.GetName] approaches the co-ordinates specified by the signal, it begins to report spatial distortions and curious lensing effects - a rich stream of valuable data. Then the transmission becomes distorted. What happens next is analyzed exhaustively.

The excitement in Science Officer [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]'s voice tautens to fear as the ship's hull struggles under increasingly exotic conditions. The ship triggers a distress call. [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] cries out "the worm!" - or, perhaps, §Hthe Worm§!! Then all transmissions end. No trace of the [Root.GetName] is ever found - no further transmissions, no debris, and the space at those co-ordinates is innocuous and utterly free of distortions. But the data they sent back has advanced our Physics research dramatically. Perhaps it was worth their lives.

label.zh: 光孕育黑暗，黑暗也笼罩光。
唯有学习，方能进步。
label.en: We learn, and we go on.

label.zh: 我们会铭记他们的牺牲的。

titles.zh: 视界信号： - 讯息结束 -

descriptions.zh: [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]以不情愿却又如释重负的态度配合着我们的工作。相关人员的认知报告随后表明他们在被无尽的幻象所支配——不存在的迷宫，在无边无际的空间中伴随而来的眩晕，在黑暗中被不断地被呼唤着名字。终于，在一个母星年之后，信号消失了。
descriptions.en: [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] complies with a mixture of reluctance and relief. Their cognitive report later indicates that they are subject to recurring visions - of impossible labyrinths, the hungry vertigo of interstellar space, and their name called in the dark. Within a homeworld year, the message has ceased.

label.zh: 我们逃过了一劫。

label.zh: 我们错失了大好机会。

descriptions.zh: 在[horizonsignal_system.GetName]星系内的黑洞再一次活跃了起来。和之前一样，一个循环播放的信号在普通空间的边缘不断地闪烁。但是这次不同的是，在这个信号内有一段声音编码。听起来仿佛就是[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]的声音。“已行的将再行”，[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]吟诵着，“将行的终为已行。”然后和第一个信号出现的同一个坐标再次浮现，在[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]失踪的坐标——媒体将之称为“出口点”。接着信号提到了一个新的名字：§G[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: The black hole in [horizonsignal_system.GetName] is active again. Once again, a looping signal flickers in the darkness at the edge of normal space. But this time, there's an acoustic message encoded in the signal. It sounds very like [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]'s voice. "What was shall be," [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] intones, "what shall be was." Then the same co-ordinates as the first signal, the co-ordinates where [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] was lost - what the media has christened "the Exit Point." Then they say a name: §G[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]§!.

label.zh: 把[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]派遣到出口点。

tooltips.zh: §H[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]§!会在§Y30天§!内抵达出口点。
tooltips.en: §H[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]§! will arrive at the Exit Point in §Y30 days§!.

label.zh: [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]自愿前往。批准。

tooltips.en: §H[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]§! will arrive at the Exit Point in §Y30 days§!.

label.zh: 派遣他过去，但是要在舰船引擎上装上爆炸装置。
label.en: Send them, but rig their ship's drive to detonate.

tooltips.en: §H[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]§! will arrive at the Exit Point in §Y30 days§!.

label.zh: 允许他们前往，但是要在舰船引擎装上爆炸装置。
label.en: Permit them to go, but rig their ship's drive to detonate.

tooltips.zh: §H[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]§!会在§Y30天§!内抵达出口点。
tooltips.en: §H[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]§! will arrive at the Exit Point in §Y30 days§!.

label.zh: 这次可不行。无视掉吧。

descriptions.zh:
这一次，船只完全处于自动驾驶。[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]是船上唯一的乘员。当他接近出口点的时候，遥测仪器上充满了令人着迷的数据。又一次，空间产生扭曲，引力产生的巨大涟漪将时空撕开。[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]冷静地读取数据，并对遥测仪器进行调整。监视小组如释重负：所幸这一次我们派遣了一个专家。然而，当有人意识到有事情即将发生的时候，一切为时已晚。

[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]不再理会这些数据：他已经开始预测了。遥测开始和预测出现不一致，但是仅仅持续了几秒钟，就和预测的结果完全一致。当监测小组汇报预言的间隔在不断增加时，[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]惊讶的说道：“我穿过来了。”

“这里一片黑暗，”他们补充到，“这没问题。我们能在黑暗下生活。我还从未想过可以这样。但是当然了，如果螶赐予我们它的爱，我们就可以得到永生——”

就在此刻，信号中断，然后船只从我们的传感器中消失。
descriptions.en:
This time, the ship is running fully automated. [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] is the only crew-member aboard. As it approaches the Exit Point, the telemetry stream fills up with fascinating data. Once again, space flexes, gravity uncoils. [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] reads off the headline data, echoing the telemetry. They are commendably calm: we've sent a professional. It takes a little while for anyone to realize that something is peculiar about the timing.

[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] is no longer echoing the data: they're predicting it. The telemetry disagrees, but only for a few seconds, until it catches up. The monitoring team is just reporting that the prediction interval is increasing when [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] says, wonderingly: "I'm through."

"It's dark," they add. "That's not a problem. We can live in the dark. I never thought of that. But of course, we can live here forever - if the Worm will only wait - "

At that moment, the signal cuts out, and the ship disappears from our team's sensors.

label.zh: 这太可怕了。

label.zh: 真遗憾。

label.zh: 令人着迷。

descriptions.zh:
这一次，[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]是船上唯一的乘员。船只完全处于自动驾驶……并且它的系统被设置为只要和上一艘船只失踪时候的情况一样就立即爆炸。当他接近出口点的时候，遥测流式仪器瞬间涌现了巨量引人注目的数据。又一次，空间产生扭曲，引力将时空展开。[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]冷静地读取数据，与遥测的结果完全一致。监视小组如释重负：我们派遣了一个专家。可惜，当有人意识到有事情即将发生的时候，一切为时已晚。

[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]现在并不是在报这些数据：他已经开始预测数据了。遥测读数开始和预测值并不符合，但是仅仅持续了几秒钟，就和预测的结果完全一致。正当监测小组汇报称预测间隔不断增加时，传感器探测到了一次能量激增。

船只被引爆了：星空中喷涌而出一团火焰，然后快速的消失在[horizonsignal_system.GetName]的黑暗中。不管我们在那里遭遇了什么，那个存在都会要后悔把我们拖下水了。不过我们将永远无法知道真相了。视界信号再也没有出现。我们的团队或许能在舰船残骸中找到些什么。
descriptions.en:
This time, [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] is the only crew-member aboard. The ship is running fully automated... and its systems are programmed to detonate the drive once conditions match those immediately prior to the last ship's disappearance. As it approaches the exit point, the telemetry stream fills up with fascinating data. Once again, space flexes, gravity uncoils. [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] reads off the headline data, echoing the telemetry. They are commendably calm: we've sent a professional. It takes a little while for anyone to realize that something is peculiar about the timing.

[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName] is no longer echoing the data: They're predicting it. The telemetry disagrees, but only for a few seconds, until it catches up. Our monitoring team is just reporting that the prediction interval is increasing when there is a sudden energy spike.

The drive has detonated: a brief flare of stellar fury, quickly lost in the darkness of [horizonsignal_system.GetName]. Whatever we encountered there, it may regret its interference. We'll never know. The Horizon Signal does not come again. But our team may find something interesting in the ashes of the ship.

label.zh: 然而，这事情或许没这么容易结束。
label.en: And yet, this may not be the end.

descriptions.zh: 我们重现了黑洞周围近似的情况。我们发现我们之前回收的碎片，以一种几乎不可能的方式，在各种状态之间循环——好像时间在过去和未来之间震荡一样。我们可以从中提取一些能源——虽然有人担心这会对本地时空造成糟糕的影响。
descriptions.en: We've reproduced conditions that approximate those around the black hole. We've found that the fragments we recover cycle between states, in ways that should be impossible - as if time were oscillating. We can derive energy from this - although there are worrying changes to local spacetime.

descriptions.zh:
又一次，来自[horizonsignal_system.GetName]的视界信号被激活了。这次势头更劲。又一次，传输的信息中包含了出口点的坐标。它同时附带了[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]和[horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]的私人通信密钥。但是这次不同，这次的信号是一个用古老的编程语言编译的一个文本程序生成的，呃，情诗——这些爱情诗句饱含了对[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]的爱意。

老实说，这些情诗让人瘆得慌。但是事实是，我们的科学家们一致认为，用程序写情诗是很难实现的，而且让一个黑洞发送情诗实在是破天荒的第一次。
descriptions.en:
Once again, the Horizon Signal in [horizonsignal_system.GetName] is active. It has upped its game. Once again, the transmission includes the Exit Point's co-ordinates. It's signed with the private comm keys of [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName] and [horizonsignal_secondleader.GetName]. But this time, it's a generative text program written in an elderly programming language that creates what appear to be love poems - love poems directed to [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName].

They're honestly not very good love poems. But it is, our scientists agree, quite difficult to generate love poems procedurally, and quite unusual for a black hole to send love poems at all.

label.zh: 嗯，对方既然这么有礼，那就把[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]派过去吧。

descriptions.zh:
“我这次是回不来了，”[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]在出发前的简报中说道，“我知道我回不来的。但我早就预料到这种事会发生。那黑洞的里面的东西已经等了我们很久了——我感觉，早在我出生之前，他们就在等我了。”

再一次，只载有一名人员的飞船接近了出口点。再一次，空间如同沸腾一般扭曲起来。再一次，我们的传感器列阵传回了不可思议的数据。但这一次，[horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName]却十分沉寂。遥感信号变得断断续续，随后，也归于沉寂。飞船到达了出口点。周围的环境回归了正常。却什么也没发生。

什么也没发生？监测团队气愤地低语着。但飞船却变化了……其实，我们观测的已经是另一艘船了。我们发现的是[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]的飞船，在消失了这么多年之后，现在却从出口点缓缓飘了出来。派出的回收队伍发现飞船完好无损，但是空无一物——乘员都消失了，也没有打斗的痕迹。但却留下了一篇[horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]署名的日志，标题为§H过去即未来§!。我们的科学家紧张地对其进行了调查。“这不可能。”一位科学家说道。另一位则回应：“但愿真的不可能吧。”

飞船被重新命名为“浪子号”并回归了队伍。不知信号是暂时休眠，还是已经彻底死亡，总之再也没有出现。
descriptions.en:
"This will be the end of me," [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName] says at the briefing before launch. "I know I won't come back. But I think I always knew this would happen. Whatever is in the hole has been waiting for us for a long long time - I think it's been waiting for me, since before I was born."

Once again, the single-pilot ship approaches the Exit Point. Once again, space boils like a fever. Again, our sensor arrays soak up fascinating data. This time, [horizonsignal_thirdleader.GetName] is silent. The telemetry becomes intermittent; and then it, too, is silent. The ship has reached the Exit Point. The conditions around it are returning to normal. Nothing has happened.

Nothing? The monitoring team mutter furiously. The ship is different... in fact, it's a different ship. It's [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]'s vessel, lost these years past, drifting now away from the Exit Point. A salvage team finds it pristine and empty - no trace of crew, and no sign of violence. But there's a journal entry in [horizonsignal_firstleader.GetName]'s name, titled §HWHAT WAS WILL BE§!. Our scientists review it nervously. "Impossible," one says. "I hope so," says another.

The ship is renamed the "Foundling" and returned to service. The Signal, dead or sleeping, says nothing at all, ever again.

label.zh: 然而，这事情或许没这么容易结束。
label.en: And yet, this may not be the end.

descriptions.zh:
考古学家在[Root.GetName]偏远的高原地区发现了一座被遗忘的寺庙——被埋葬了几个世纪，但是最近因为地震而显露出来。，定年技术指出这是一座[Owner.Species.GetHandName]凿出来的前工业时代的遗迹。然而，墙壁上不断循环的标志和放射状的祭坛——一个莫比乌斯环一样的衔尾蛇——我们的早期历史中并没有这样的先例，并且在它的碑文上用了未知的文字体系。一个激动的考古学家认为这个遗迹是某个未知的先驱者物种所遗留下来的。

虽然看似无关，然而地震看起来是和在[horizonsignal_system.GetName]传出最后信息的时候的同一时间发生的。
descriptions.en:
Archaeologists have found a forgotten temple in the remote highlands of [Root.GetName] - buried for centuries, but recently exposed by an earthquake. Dating techniques suggest it's a pre-industrial relic, [Owner.Species.GetHandName]-hewn from volcanic rock. However, the recurring symbol on the walls and radial altar - a Möbius-looped serpent consuming its own tail - has no obvious precedent in our early history, and the inscriptions use an unknown alphabet. One excitable archaeologist suggests it's a relic left by an unknown precursor species.

In a presumably meaningless coincidence, the quake seems to have occurred at the same time as the final message from the black hole in [horizonsignal_system.GetName].

label.zh: 一条道路为我们打开了。
label.en: A way has been opened for us.

label.zh: 这值得我们研究。
不祥之兆。

titles.en: The Loop Temple: Time and Stone

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家对地下神殿进行了深入的调查，但是仍然存在一些无法解释的问题。在星状祭坛上的延展线上的屋顶上有一个空洞，我们推测它应该曾被作为日晷使用；但是因为地震造成的严重损毁导致我们无法确定。如果它是在某个重要的时刻建立起来的话，我们可能永远没法确认那个时间。我们在“未知语言系统”方面运气不错。这是一个因年代久远而模糊不清但十分著名的僧侣手抄——用的根本不是外星语言——并且我们已经成功的破译了它。

这个神殿被用于侍奉“时间蠕虫”或者说是§H时之螶§!。大多数铭文都充满韵律和诗意，祈祷着时之螶的降临——或者，如果反过来读的话——它的离开。它还有一部分在描述“宇宙的运转”，激动的考古学家发誓这里面引用了先进的场方程——对我们而言这个东西并不新鲜，但是但其被发现于这个古老的神殿这一事件本身就让人印象深刻了。尽管我们还没找到同意该观点并且公开承认的物理学家。

就目前而言，这个神殿没有任何与宇宙的秘密或外星武器相关的迹象。但它黑暗的环境是那么的与众不同，充满着危机感的美，而那些用于侍奉时之螶的诗文则变的时髦起来。它们被制成流行音乐传播；同时它们也被编成合集出版发行。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists have learned a great deal about the subterranean temple, but some questions remain. A roof aperture - along with the radial altar - suggests it was once a solar calendar, but it's so badly damaged by the earthquake that we can't be certain. If the builders found any particular dates important, we'll never know which ones. We've had better luck with the "unknown alphabet." It's a debased variant of a better-known hieratic script - not an alien language at all - and we've successfully deciphered it.

The temple is dedicated to the "Waiting Worm" or the §HWorm-in-Waiting§!. Most of the inscriptions are sonorous, poetic invocations requesting its appearance or - if read in the other direction - its departure. There is also a body of inscriptions describing the "operations of the universe," which our more excitable archaeologist swears contains references to advanced field equations - nothing new to us, but very impressive for a temple of this vintage. We have yet to find a physicist who's prepared to go on record in agreeing that the references are meaningful, though.

The temple holds no cosmic secrets or alien weapons, as far as we can tell, but its dark spaces have a distinctive, menacing beauty - and the poetry of the invocations to the Worm-in-Waiting becomes fashionable. They are set to popular music; they are published in collections.

tooltips.en: Something from our past. What was, will be.

label.en: Make the Loop Temple a place of pilgrimage.

tooltips.zh: 一份来自我们先驱者的智慧。“已行之事，终将再行”。这将增加星球幸福度并产生一些其他效果。
tooltips.en: A wisdom from the faith of our predecessors. What was, will be. Increases planet happiness, among other things.

label.en: Reserve the Temple for academic study only.

tooltips.zh: 只允许必要的人接触吧。
tooltips.en: Let's limit access to those who need it.

label.en: There is something wrong here. Seal the Temple.

tooltips.en: Better safe than sorry.

titles.zh: 信使：§H已行之事，终将再行§!

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]定位到了一个小体积、只有基本能源供应的物体，仅仅在当地的范围内循环广播着信号。这类物体通常都被作为逃生舱使用，看起来这个就是那些东西之一。它来到这里已经有非常久的时间了。

当工作人员把它打开的时候——谨慎遵守着隔离守则——他们发现了一些古代的遗物，被放在无菌环境舱内保藏着。到此时为止，一切都是正常的。然而，[Root.GetName]的队长表明，他们并没有料到能够寻找到[Root.Owner.GetAdj]词汇§H已行之事，终将再行；将行之事，必为已行§!——用那个救生舱乘员的体液涂抹在舱壁上——船员们挖苦的把它称作“信使”。他们添加补充道：信使的物种类别和我们的物种类别上有一些意想不到的相似之处。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has located a small, minimally powered artificial object, broadcasting a looping signal at local range only. These sorts of things usually turn out to be escape pods, and this looks like one of those. It's been out here a long time.

When the crew cracks it open - carefully observing quarantine procedures - they find ancient remains, preserved by the sterile pod environment. So far, not unusual. The captain of the [Root.GetName] indicates, however, that they did not expect to find the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] words §HWHAT WAS, WILL BE; WHAT WILL BE, WAS§! daubed on the wall in the bodily fluids of the pod's occupant - who the crew are now wryly referring to as "the Messenger". They add that there are some equally unexpected similarities between the Messenger's species, and our own.

label.zh: 真是有趣。

descriptions.zh: 我们已经确定了那个逃生舱在星系文明的早期是一件在市面贩售的典型仿制品——没有任何的新科技或者其他的特别信息。信使的残骸，相对来说就显得额外引人注目。它明显是[Root.Owner.GetAdj]的先驱或者是变种。我们或许在那里有远亲——或者我们的遗传基因被某个先驱物种进行了实验。[researchingscientist.GetName]要求允许进行更广泛的研究。
descriptions.en: We've established that the escape pod was a commercially available knockoff typical in the previous phase of galactic civilization - no new technologies or other insights. The remains of the Messenger, however, are another matter. It's unmistakably a predecessor or a variant of the [Root.Owner.GetAdj] species. We may have kin out there - or we were subjected to experiments by a precursor race. [researchingscientist.GetName] is requesting permission to conduct more extensive research.

label.zh: 准许继续研究。
提供研究资金。
不允许。并且[researchingscientist.GetName]必须放弃现在的研究。
label.en: No. And [researchingscientist.GetName] must release their existing research.

tooltips.zh: 有些事情最好还是不知道的好。
tooltips.en: There are some things it's better not to know.

descriptions.zh:
[researchingscientist.GetName]重构了信使的物种信息。它比我们虚弱，但是认知能力相比有着显著的提升。目前还需要辨明信使究竟是先有了我们，才有了修改版的信使，还是说信使就是我们的祖先。对于我们来说，想象自己是一个如此贫弱的种族的后裔是一件有点尴尬的事情——但是[researchingscientist.GetName]坚信这个观点。事实上，他认为我们种族认知能力上的落后实在是一种“悲剧”。

这一“充满悲剧的现状”驱使其接受实验性疗法来把自己的生理机能改造成和信使一样。他强调称这将会让自己能更好地进行这个计划。
descriptions.en:
[researchingscientist.GetName] has reconstructed the Messenger species. It's feebler than ours but has significantly improved cognitive abilities. There needs to be some clarification about whether we were the source species and the Messenger the modified version or whether the Messenger was our predecessor. It is a little embarrassing to imagine that we might have descended from such an effete species - but [researchingscientist.GetName] is firmly of that opinion. Indeed, they consider the loss of cognitive abilities a "tragedy."

Such a tragedy that they have undergone experimental treatments to alter their physiology to that of the Messengers. They insist this will equip them much better to continue the project.

label.zh: 变相的叛国行为！请立即处决他们，马上。
label.en: A creative form of treason! Execute them, please.

label.zh: 变相的叛国行为！请立即处决他们，马上。销毁所有研究笔记。
label.en: A creative form of treason! Execute them, please. Destroy their notes.

label.zh: 极好的计划！继续进行下去。
label.en: Excellent idea! Get on with it, then.

tooltips.zh: §R这可能发生显著且难以预料的后果§!
tooltips.en: §RThis may have significant and unpredictable consequences§!

descriptions.zh: [researchingscientist.GetName]现在已经重构了信使物种的起源。他同时还重建了一种强传染性的病毒。这种病毒会在我们的星球中潜伏，一旦感染上我们的首要物种，便会使其陷入蛹样昏迷，并在一天后转变为信使物种。这样的转变，讲道理，让一些人兴奋不已。
descriptions.en: [researchingscientist.GetName] has now sequenced the origins of the Messenger species. Coincidentally, they have also recreated a highly contagious virus. It stalks our worlds. Under its influence, our primary species falls into a chrysalis coma and emerges a day later as the Messenger species. These transformations are, understandably, causing some excitement.

label.zh: 做得太过火了，现在我们必须终结这一切。将扩散控制住。
label.en: This has gone too far. Now we end it. Control the outbreak.

他们的外貌、思潮和特质都可能发生明显的转变。

All pops on the capital planet will be converted, but there it will end.
Their appearance, ethics and traits are likely to undergo significant changes.

label.en: Control the outbreak, and purge all affected citizens.

tooltips.zh: 这将会§R净化所有受感染人口§!：几乎是[Root.Capital.GetName]上的全部人口。
tooltips.en: This will §RPurge all affected Pops§!: nearly the entire population of [Root.Capital.GetName].

label.zh: 已行之事，必将再行。我们将已改变。给我来一针病毒吧。
label.en: What was, shall be. We will change. Bring me a sample of the virus.

tooltips.zh:
这将会转变我们整个物种。
我们的外貌、思潮和特质都可能发生明显的转变。
tooltips.en:
This will transform our entire species.
Our appearance, ethics and traits are likely to undergo significant changes.

descriptions.zh:
[researchingscientist9220.GetName]对信使的基因进行了重组研究。他们的确十分出色，但也令我们的科学家有些担忧。与我们现在的基因相比较，信使明显更为强健，攻击意愿也更高。现在研究人员们众说纷纭，亟待确定信使到底是我们自身的进化版本，还是说他们其实是我们的祖先。[researchingscientist9220.GetName]本人更相信后一种说法——我们本也应当作为强大的战斗物种生活下去，却因为某个先驱文明的干涉而失去了战斗本能。据其认为，失去这种战斗能力乃是我方史上最大的“悲剧”。

有些研究人员甚至为此接受实验性治疗，将自己的体质改造成了信使的特征。他们还坚持认为，这对研究的继续进行具有重大意义。
descriptions.en:
[researchingscientist9220.GetName] has reconstructed the Messenger. It's, ah, quite impressive - worryingly so. It is considerably more robust and aggressive than our current edition. There needs to be some clarification about whether we were the source species, the Messenger modified version, or whether the Messenger was our predecessor. [researchingscientist9220.GetName] firmly believes that we were once much more of a warrior species and that some meddling precursor muzzled our potential. Indeed, they consider losing our martial abilities a "tragedy."

Such a tragedy that they have undergone experimental treatments to alter their physiology to that of the Messengers. They insist that this will equip them much better to continue the project.

label.en: A creative form of treason! Execute them, please.

descriptions.en: [researchingscientist9220.GetName] has now sequenced the origins of the Messenger species. Without stopping to ask anyone's opinion, they have also recreated a highly contagious virus. It stalks our worlds. Under its influence, our primary species falls into a chrysalis-coma and emerges a day later as the Messenger species. This is causing - it is fair to say - some excitement.

tooltips.en: This will purge all affected pops - nearly the entire population of [Root.Capital.GetName].

label.en: What was, shall be. Circulate a sample of the virus.

tooltips.en: This will transform our entire species.

descriptions.zh: [Root.Owner.GetName]的§H“朔望”号§!……向[Root.GetName]致以问候。尽管“朔望”号没有向我们发送任何可以识别的身份代码，记录在案的船只中也没有哪艘船是这个名字。它的指挥官宣称自己是舰长§H[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] is being hailed... by the "§HSyzygy§!" of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. This, despite the fact the "Syzygy" isn't sending any ID codes we recognize, and no ship of that name has ever been commissioned. Its commanding officer claims to be Captain §H[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]§!.

label.zh: 嗯。我们确实有这么一位指挥官，不过我得找找。
label.en: Hm. Our commander of that name is alive, well and elsewhere.

tooltips.zh: 打开频道。
tooltips.en: Open a channel.

label.zh: 真是有趣。[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]在这里。

tooltips.zh: 打开频道。
tooltips.en: Open a channel.

label.zh: 这*一定*是一个陷阱。我们不会给敌人机会。做好战斗准备。
label.en: This *must* be an ambush. We're taking no chances. Battlestations.

titles.en: A Rendezvous: the Captain that Was

descriptions.zh:
出现在屏幕上的舰长明显是[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]，但是却伤痕累累，心神不宁，衰老，就像是[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]的失意版，光滑的面庞被等离子体灼烧过一样，并且比苍老还要老。背景里的舰桥看起来伤痕累累，并且很残旧。但是船长的声音还是很坚定而且洪亮

§G“终于找到你们了，我等待了很久了，我的惩罚是在和你的战斗中死去。请杀死我，很抱歉。”§!
descriptions.en:
The Captain that appears on our screen is clearly [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName], but a scarred, haunted, decrepit, wrecked edition of [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName], face glossy with plasma-burns, and older - much older. The bridge in the background looks just as scarred and just as decrepit. But the Captain's voice is firm and clear.

§G"FINALLY you're here. I've waited so long. My punishment is to die in battle against you. Please, end me. I'm sorry."§!

label.zh: 这究竟是怎么一回事？你真的是[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]？
label.en: What's happening here? Are you really [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]?

label.zh: 如果你想终结它，那为何还等待？一艘战舰有的是办法自灭。
label.en: If you want to end it, why wait? A warship is full of ways to die.

label.zh: 圆环是什么？
投降吧，不论你做过什么，我们都可以帮助你。
label.en: Surrender. Whatever you've done, we can help you.

label.zh: 杀戮不是我们的处世之道。投降吧，我们会帮助你的。
label.en: Killing is not our way. Surrender, and we'll help you.

label.zh: 那么，就让我们做个了断吧。
好吧，在你……之前：你能否提供任何有帮助的资料？
label.en: Before you go: did you learn anything useful?

label.zh: 我们会为你祈祷的。
label.en: We'll remember you in our prayers.

label.zh: 船长。我们会在烈火和荣耀中重逢。
label.en: Captain. We'll meet in fire, and honor.

label.zh: 那么，就让我们做个了断吧。
叛徒。

tooltips.zh: 关闭频道。
tooltips.en: Close channel.

titles.en: A Rendezvous: the Captain that Was

descriptions.zh:
§G“[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]完毕。”§!

船长向我们致敬——做动作时旧伤口在不断地抽搐着——然后关闭了传输。
descriptions.en:
§G"[mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName] out."§!

The captain salutes - wincing as the movement tugs at an old wound - and closes the connection.

descriptions.zh: “朔望”号正在启动武器。
descriptions.en: The "Syzygy" is powering weapons.

label.zh: 各战斗单位就位！

options.script: name = BATTLESTATIONS

descriptions.zh:
在[syzygy_location.GetStarName]内，收到了一个来自于“朔望”号船长的静态雪点信息。在他们身后，舰桥被烟雾环绕。§G“太晚了，你离开它的时间太久了。圆环从不宽恕。求求——”§!

信息到此为止。
descriptions.en:
A static-speckled message comes in from the captain of the "Syzygy", in [syzygy_location.GetStarName]. Behind them, the bridge is wreathed in smoke. §G"Too late. You left it too long. The Loop won't forgive me. Please -"§!

The message ends there.

label.zh: 确认

descriptions.zh: [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName]在随后的这几天一直沉默。毕竟被宣判死亡不是一件可以简单放下的事情。所幸不久之后，他的沉默变成了果断，并最终成为笑对危险的豁达。
descriptions.en: [mirrored_syzygy_admiral.GetName] is silent in the days that follow. It is no small thing to order your own death. But in time, that silence becomes a determination, and an almost reckless confidence.

descriptions.zh: 在随后几年间，有几起目击报告称指挥官[From.GetName]于[Root.GetAdj]的空间及更远的地方出现过。当一位著名的领袖逝世，这种事情并不罕见；而自朔望相会事件以来，他们已经成为了一种传奇。只是我们无法分辨这类事情的真伪。
descriptions.en: In the years that follow, there are reported sightings of Commander [From.GetName] across [Root.GetAdj] space and beyond. When a celebrated leader dies, this kind of thing is not unknown, of course; and they had become a kind of legend since the Syzygy Rendezvous. But we can't be sure.

label.zh: 我们看来是永远也不会知道了。

descriptions.zh:
取证分析认为我们恢复的残骸有着堂而皇之的诡异之处。飞船的所有部位全都是在同一时间建造出来的——使用的技术几乎和我们是同一水平——但是有些部件看起来却相比其他的要古老几百年。已经恢复的一组动力电池比它本来的样子还要好。

此外……两个被分配于该任务的分析师出乎意料的从慢性病中痊愈了——这种慢性病，据说是根本无法治愈的。然而这个队伍却对此事的原因茫然不知。
descriptions.en:
The forensic analysis of the remnants we've recovered has uncovered oddities. All parts of the ship were constructed at the same time - using techniques that match our own methods of construction - but some components appear to be hundreds of years older than others. A power cell that we've recovered performs much better than it should.

Furthermore... two analysts that were assigned to the project have recovered unexpectedly from chronic health problems - in one case, a possibly terminal condition. The team is at a loss to account for this.

label.zh: 确认

descriptions.zh: 我们在[coils_planet.GetName]的观测站汇报称一股边缘化的宗教艺术运动——神之圆环，正在崛起。原始的机械钟被认为是圣物，但是在运行一年之后就会被仪式般的毁掉。星球上的蠕虫状和蛇状物被保护免受损害。时间，神之圆环的祭司称，是一个迷宫。“已行之事，必将再行；将行之事，终为已行。”他们在祈祷中这样吟咏道。
descriptions.en: Our observation station on [coils_planet.GetName] reports the rise of an unusual minority religious-artistic movement, the Coils of God. Primitive mechanical clocks are considered holy, but ritually destroyed after a year's operation. The worm- and serpent-analogues of the planets are protected from harm. Time, the Coils-priests say, is a labyrinth. "What was, will be; what will be, was" they intone in their prayers.

label.zh: 这话好像在哪里听过。尽我们最大的努力镇压。
label.en: This sounds familiar. Suppress it as best we can.

label.zh: 这话好像在哪里听过。尽我们所可能的接近观察。
label.en: This sounds familiar. Observe it as closely as we can.

titles.en: The Coils of God: a Subtle Persecution

descriptions.zh: 我们设法让[coils_planet.GetName]上的当地统治者相信，神之圆环是一个威胁。神之圆环的祭司们被劝阻，被囚禁，或者，遗憾的，被火刑。前超光速文明看来对于如何栽培仇恨和猜忌了然于心：有时这些手段很有用。
descriptions.en: We've convinced native rulers that the Coils of God cult on [coils_planet.GetName] is a threat. The Coils-priests have been discouraged, imprisoned, or, regrettably, incinerated. Pre-FTL species have access to a deep well of hatred and suspicion: there are times when that's very useful.

label.zh: 确认

options.script: name = OK

titles.en: The Coils of God: Deep Roots

descriptions.zh: 我们已经设法让[coils_planet.GetName]上的当地统治者相信，神之圆环是一个威胁。神之圆环的祭司们被劝阻，被囚禁，或者，遗憾的，被火刑。但是信徒们依旧顽强，我们的观察者表示担忧。认为并称他们只是转入地下活动了。
descriptions.en: We've convinced native rulers that the Coils of God cult on [coils_planet.GetName] is a threat. The Coils-priests have been discouraged, imprisoned, or, regrettably, incinerated. But the cult is tenacious, and our observers express concerns that it may just have gone underground.

label.zh: 确认

titles.en: The Coils of God: the Labyrinth Ceremonies

descriptions.zh: [coils_planet.GetName]上的神之圆环的狂热信徒正在以不寻常的速度激增。在星球的每个城市上都可以找到他们，并且他们创造出了一系列在各行各业由公民主导的仪式。整个种族对此都抱有不合常理的热情。富人编排出精致的圆环舞蹈来进行他们的庆祝。穷人则在他们的门上贴满复杂的圆环标识。甚至连游乐场里的游戏都在颂扬时间的自然之圆。
descriptions.en: The Coils of God cult on [coils_planet.GetName] has grown with unusual speed. It can be found in every city on the planet, and it's fostering a series of lengthy ceremonies conducted by citizens in every walk of life. The whole species has taken to them with unlikely enthusiasm. The rich adopt elaborate circular dances for their celebrations. The poor daub complex looping sigils on their doors. Even playground games are chants about the circular nature of time.

label.zh: 这让人心绪不宁。干涉并制止他们，但是做的巧妙一些。
label.en: This is unsettling. Intervene to shut it down, but subtly.

label.zh: 事态严重了。用武力迫使他们停止，不论代价和风险。
label.en: This is serious. Use force to shut it down, whatever the risks.

label.zh: 令人着迷！派一支队伍去学习仪式 —— 去参加，如果可行的话。
label.en: Fascinating! Send a team to study the rites- to participate, if possible.

label.zh: 原始人干的原始事。继续观察。
label.en: Primitives do primitive things. Continue to observe.

titles.en: The Coils of God: Ceremony's End

descriptions.zh: 我们的破坏活动瓦解了神之圆环信徒在[coils_planet.GetName]上的仪式。贵族放弃了他们的礼拜。墙上环形涂鸦慢慢褪色。年轻人的重心回到了调情，谋杀和其他有益健康的童年消遣。神之圆环的祭司中有大量的自杀行为。如果这是一个危机，或许已经过去了。
descriptions.en: Our campaign of subversion has disrupted the Coils of God ceremonies on [coils_planet.GetName]. The nobility abandon their cult. The looping graffiti on walls fades. The young return to playground games about flirtation, murder and other healthy childhood pastimes. There is a rash of suicides among Coils-priests. If there was a crisis, perhaps it is past.

label.zh: “圆环永不终止，但非每次都能闭合。”
label.en: "The Loop never ends, but it is not always completed."

options.script: name = akx.9460.a

label.zh: 干的很好，所有人。解除警备。

options.script: name = akx.9460.b

titles.en: The Coils of God: News from Underground

descriptions.zh: 我们的破坏活动瓦解了神之圆环信徒在[coils_planet.GetName]上的仪式——但是只是浇灭了祭司们的热情。如今，他们秘密行动，结会于地下的寺庙。贵族们不再跳迷宫一般的舞蹈，但是他们依然佩戴者虫行标记。并且“已行之事，必将再行”的儿歌仍然回响在游乐场上。
descriptions.en: Our campaign of subversion has disrupted the Coils of God ceremonies on [coils_planet.GetName] - but it only fires the Coils-priests' fervor. They meet in secret, now, in subterranean temples. The nobility no longer dance the labyrinth dances, but they still bear hidden tattoos of the Sign of the Worm. And chants of "what was, shall be" still echo in playgrounds.

label.zh: “圆环永不终止。”

options.script: name = akx.9465.a

label.zh: 继续观察。

options.script: name = akx.9465.b

titles.en: The Coils of God: the Blood of Priests

descriptions.zh: 我们的特工锋利如刀。他们对每个能找到的圆圈祭司进行绑架或者暗杀。他们用爆药拆除了有着圆环标记的住宅。[coils_planet.GetName]四处充满着谣言说神之圆环亵渎了神明，唤醒了愤怒的上帝。不久以后，在没有借助任何我方的帮助下，本地人彻底地击垮了神之圆环。观察员收到了惊吓；但是如果这是一个危机的话，现在已经被避免了。
descriptions.en: Our operatives are merciless. They abduct or assassinate every Coils-priest they can find. They set demolition charges on houses bearing the mark of the Loop. [coils_planet.GetName] is alive with rumors that the Coils' blasphemy has aroused the wrath of a greater god. Before long, the natives are beating the Coils-priests to death without any assistance from our operatives. The observation team is horrified; but if there was a crisis, it has been averted.

label.zh: “圆环永不终止，但非每次都能闭合。”
label.en: "The Loop never ends, but it is not always completed."

options.script: name = akx.9470.a

label.zh: 干的很好，所有人。解除警备。

options.script: name = akx.9470.b

titles.en: The Coils of God: Navigating the Labyrinth

descriptions.zh:
我们的人种学者着迷于复杂的仪式中。他们猜测仪式中暗含某种隐秘的通讯频道，于是决定对隐写祷文进行重编，并用算法重构仪式。事实上，他们传回的证据已经初步证实了这些——直到通讯被突然中断。事实上，在全球范围内，所有的通讯都戛然而止。来自卫星和地面调查飞行器的报告表明：星球上没有活动迹象。没有任何交通工具在路上行驶，没有任何的居住区存在热岛或者排放。没有生命特征……

最终报告表明，[coils_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]整个星球的全部人口 —— 包括我们的人种学团队——都消失了，随之所有的活动都以一种非暴力的形式刹然而止。食物没吃完就离开了，宠物也没有喂食，住宅被无人管理的火炉点燃。重力异常在开始的时候就被记录了下来。几乎在每条街道，都有着粉刷的环形标识证明。
descriptions.en:
Our ethnographers are fascinated by the complexity of the ceremonies. They hypothesize secret communication channels, steganographic prayer-encodings, or algorithmic underpinnings to the rituals. In fact, they're returning preliminary evidence of this last when their communications abruptly cease. In fact, all communication seems to have ceased, planet-wide. Reports from satellites and survey craft flyovers confirm: there is no activity on the planet at all. No vehicles moving on the road, no emissions or thermal signatures in population centers. No signs of life...

And here's the final report. The entire [coils_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] population of the planet - including your ethnography team - is absent, with all the business of a sudden but not violent exit. Meals were left unfinished, pets unfed, the occasional house aflame from an unattended stove. Gravitational anomalies were recorded at the assumed time of departure. In almost every street, the looped chalk sigils of the Coils bear witness.

label.zh: “圆环永不终止。”

titles.en: The Coils of God: Empty Temples

descriptions.zh:
一份来自我们在[coils_planet.GetName]上的观察团队的报告称：神之圆环的仪式停止了。事实上，覆盖全球的活动迹象看起来处于最低记录。汇报表明观察小队正打算用秘密飞行器在低海拔高度穿过居住区探测……

后续报告证实了：星球上没有活动迹象。没有任何交通工具在路上行驶，没有任何的居住区存在热岛或者排放。没有生命特征……

最终报告表明，[coils_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]整个星球的全部人口都消失了，随之所有的活动都以一种非暴力的形式戛然而止：食物没吃完就离开了，宠物也没有喂食，住宅被无人管理的火炉点燃。重力异常在开始的时候就被记录了下来。几乎在每条街道，都有着粉刷的环形标识证明。
descriptions.en:
A report has come in from our observation team on [coils_planet.GetName]: the ceremonies of the Coils of God have ceased. In fact, activity across the planet seems to be at an all-time low. The report indicates that the team are going to follow up with low-altitude passes in a stealth survey craft over major population centers...

The follow-up report confirms: there is no activity on the planet at all. No vehicles moving on the road, no emissions or thermal signatures in population centers. No signs of life...

And here's the final report. The entire [coils_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] population of the planet is absent, with all the business of a sudden but not violent exit: meals left unfinished, pets unfed, the occasional house fire. Gravitational anomalies were recorded at the assumed time of departure. In almost every street, the looped chalk sigils of the Coils bear witness.

label.zh: “圆环永不终止。”

tooltips.en: A civilization vanishes.

descriptions.zh: 显然，这不是这颗行星上[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]建立的首个据点。相当数量的设施和城市区划被仔细地封存了起来，只需通过简单的修复，我们就可以让它们重新运作服务于我们殖民地的建设。然而可疑的是，所有的历史记录均已被抹除。我们无法确定这里曾经是走私者的秘密港口，抑或是政治难民的庇护所。
descriptions.en: It appears this is not the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] settlement on this planet. A number of facilities and districts have been carefully moth-balled and, with a little restoration, will serve our new colony well. But all records have been erased. Possibly this was a smugglers' port, or a haven for political exiles.

label.zh: 太好了！马上安排修复这些设施。
label.en: Excellent! Make arrangements to restore the facilities.

label.zh: 一切都顺利的有点不真实，还是拆除这些区划吧。
label.en: This is too good to be true. Demolish the districts.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低殖民地的幸福度。
tooltips.en: This will cause unhappiness in the colony.

descriptions.zh: 我们的工程师在安装好炸药后就立马撤退到了安全距离外。目标场地在爆破之后仅留一地废墟。最终，这些废墟在风霜雨雪的冲刷下也会归于尘土。然而，这些遗迹的骨架会依然矗立着，即使经过几个世纪后依然巍然不动；此外，我们也听到了某些坊间传言，白日的石砾间有阴影撺掇，夜色的映照下有鬼火涌动。我们的殖民者们都识趣地绕开该地点。毕竟这地方可不是什么旅游胜地。
descriptions.en: Our engineers set charges and retire to a safe distance. The sites are reduced to ruins. Eventually, the ruins will crack and crumble to boulders, pebbles, dust, under the assault of wind, roots, rain. But their shell will endure for centuries yet; and there will be stories, we'll hear, of shadows in the stone by day, blue lights by night. Our colonists will avoid them. They'll attract no visitors.

label.zh: 一切都结束了。

titles.en: The Waiting World: Shadows in the Walls

descriptions.zh: 我们的殖民者很乐于利用[waiting_world.GetName]上的这些区划。它们能够让殖民地飞速发展。但是人们开始感到不安。传闻这些设施仍然有着使用者，或者是正在运行的安保措施。但是没有任何证据可证明这一点。部分殖民者甚至疑神疑鬼地坚持他们就是“墙壁中的影子”。
descriptions.en: Our settlers were initially happy to make use of the districts on [waiting_world.GetName]. Their existence jump-started the colony. But now they've grown nervous. There are rumors that the facilities may still have occupants, or active security systems, although no evidence of either has been found. Some colonists insist, enigmatically, that there are "shadows in the walls."

label.zh: 这些迷信不能被提倡。这些区划可以减少我们很多年的奋斗。
label.en: Discourage this superstition. The districts represent years of effort.

label.zh: 为何要承担风险？它们只是建筑，给我炸了。
label.en: Why take the risk? They're only buildings. Have them demolished.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低殖民地的幸福度。
tooltips.en: This will cause unhappiness in the colony.

descriptions.zh: 从[waiting_world.GetName]传来了有趣的消息，先前我们曾在此地发现遗弃的区划。一份统计发现那里突然多出了很多殖民者。不过这可能只是统计出错，毕竟那些殖民者全都拥有合法的公民身份证，而且没有人汇报发现任何新来的陌生人。肯定是那里的生育率超级高，或者是我们的数据受到了未办件移民的影响。无论如何，那里的人口增长远远超出我们的合理预期。
descriptions.en: Curious news from [waiting_world.GetName], where we found those abandoned districts. A census shows too many settlers. Records on a new colony are always unreliable, but as far as we can tell, they have authentic citizen IDs - and no one on this world has reported any mysterious strangers. Population growth must have been extraordinarily high, or perhaps our data is affected by unlicensed migration. In any case, the population has increased by more than we might reasonably expect.

label.zh: 摧毁城市区划。我们早该这么做了。
label.en: Destroy those districts. We should have done it much sooner.

tooltips.zh: 这将会降低殖民地的幸福度。
tooltips.en: This will cause unhappiness in the colony.

label.zh: 尽我们最大努力调查，对现状进行密切关注。
label.en: Investigate as best we can; keep an eye on the situation.

titles.en: The Waiting World: And Still They Come

descriptions.zh: 当初发现那些被遗弃的城市区划的[waiting_world.GetName]再次传来新消息。当地殖民者的数量持续攀升，我们最近在记录中发现了很多异常的地方——本不该存在的团体、完全解释不通的日期等等。肯定是某个未知殖民地的居民偷偷迁徙到该地，要么是有殖民者故意破坏记录误导我们。
descriptions.en: Another update from [waiting_world.GetName], where we found those abandoned facilities. The number of colonists continues to increase, and now we're finding irregularities in the records - groups that shouldn't exist, dates that make no sense. There must be a secret migration from a lost colony or some peculiar sabotage by the colonists.

label.zh: 摧毁城市区划。我们早该这么做了。
label.en: Destroy those districts. We should have done it much sooner.

label.zh: 真是奇怪！但人口总是多多益善。继续监视并维持现状。
label.en: Peculiar! But we can always use more citizens. Monitor and continue.

descriptions.zh: [waiting_world.GetName]突然发生了全球范围内的通讯中断。尽管之前我们莫名其妙的多了很多人口，然而现在，看起来，那颗星球上面已经没有任何人了。所有人在一夜之间突然蒸发。他们离开了这个世界？亦或是隐藏起来了？还是星球级的种族灭绝？
descriptions.en: An abrupt and total communications blackout from [waiting_world.GetName]. We somehow had too many people there. Now, it appears, we have no one at all. The entire population has simply vanished overnight. Have they left the world? Gone into hiding? Engaged in planet-wide genocide?

label.zh: 派一支队伍前去调查。
立即放弃并隔离这个星球。
label.en: Abandon and quarantine the world immediately.

tooltips.zh: 这会使该星球被永久弃用。
tooltips.en: This will put the planet permanently beyond use.

titles.en: The Waiting World: the Quality of Light

descriptions.zh:
我们的特遣小队报告称[waiting_world.GetName]确实、的确，空无一人——不仅仅是殖民者，甚至连殖民地的痕迹都被抹除的一干二净。建筑都消失了，卫星和轨道建筑也消失了，大气数据显示没有任何科技文明的印记。在小队的报告中，整个星球好像被重置了一样。

他们同时报告称星系内太阳辐射的波动具备准超新星的特征——伴随着一些 “闪光事件”，大气中的光线似乎是莫名其妙积累然后以五光十色的形式释放在行星表面上。这的确是一份有价值的特殊数据，但这并没有阐明殖民者们的命运。
descriptions.en:
Our team reports that [waiting_world.GetName] is, indeed, empty - not only of colonists, but of any sign the colony was ever there. The buildings are gone, the satellites and orbital structures are gone, the atmosphere shows none of the footprints of technological civilization. In the words of the team, it's as if the entire planet has been reset.

They also report fluctuations in local solar radiation that are characteristic of pre-supernova stars - and a number of "luminosity events" on the surface where light somehow appears to be accumulated and released by prismatic functions of the atmosphere. This is valuable and peculiar data. But it doesn't clarify the fate of the colonists.

label.zh: 确认

descriptions.zh:
[waiting_world.GetName]传来了更多令人诧异的报告——这个星球曾经有过神秘的人口增长。虽然目前的人口数量和我们预期的一致，但是一些信息貌似出现了点问题，或者……或者有什么我们的政府官员也无法解释的信息。报告中，这些人员没有一个存在于我们的初始记录中，最初的每一个殖民者都失踪了。看起来就像是每个居民都被陌生人完整的代替了。

当然，他们都发誓自己是忠诚的[Root.Owner.GetName]的公民。他们都可以从事生产并且显然很健康。在所有的通讯中，他们否认了那些混乱的报告信息，并且他们坚称是我们自己弄错了。
descriptions.en:
Further unlikely news from [waiting_world.GetName], where the population had been mysteriously increasing. Population numbers are now what we'd expect, but there has been some sort of information sabotage, or... or what, our administrators aren't really sure. None of the individuals on the planet exists in our records. Every original colonist is missing. It's as if they've all been replaced by complete strangers.

As against that, they all swear they're loyal citizens of [Root.Owner.GetName]. They're all productive and apparently sane. In all communications they deny all knowledge of any confusion, and insist there must be a mistake at our end.

label.zh: 在这件事进一步扩大之前，立即放弃这个殖民地。
label.en: Abandon the colony immediately, before this spreads any further.

tooltips.zh: 这将会让该殖民地独立。
tooltips.en: This will grant independence to the colony.

label.zh: 净化掉他们，并且永久隔离该星球
label.en: Purge them, and permanently quarantine the planet.

label.zh: 派一支队伍前去调查。

descriptions.zh: 这或许是一个可怕的罪行。但这或许能将我们国家从某个更加恶劣的存在中拯救出来。[waiting_world.GetName]上的殖民地在我们的火力下化为灰烬。当我们收工的时候，每一个建筑都变成了玻璃石；没有智慧生命体存活的迹象。
descriptions.en: This may have been a terrible crime. Or it may have preserved our nation from something even worse. The population centers of [waiting_world.GetName] seethe beneath the energies of our weapons. When we are done, every building is glowing rubble; no living sapient remains.

label.zh: 抹掉这些记录。再过一百年，就没人会知道我们的所作所为了。
label.en: Erase the records. In a hundred years, no one will know what we did.

label.zh: 告诉所有人这件事。无所谓他们的藐小仇恨，只要保证他们能够感受到恐惧。
label.en: Tell everyone. Let them hate, so long as they fear.

titles.en: The Waiting World: Everything and Nothing

descriptions.zh: 我们的特遣小队报告称星球上的人们都很正常健康，并显然被这些小题大作的事情弄得手足无措。虽然他们的确有些怪异：比如互无关联但长得一样的人不寻常地多、整个星球的人都对时间毫无概念、星系内太阳辐射波动具备准超新星的特征。同时他们也观测到了一些“闪光事件”，大气中的光线似乎是莫名其妙积累然后以五光十色的形式释放在行星表面上。这虽是一份有价值的特殊数据，但更像是巧合。如果在这个殖民地上曾发生过什么，那么现在都已经成为了秘密。
descriptions.en: Our team reports that the planet's population is healthy and bewildered by all the fuss. There are some peculiarities, such as an unusual number of strange coincidences, a planet-wide idiosyncrasy where no one has any regard for punctuality, and fluctuations in local solar radiation characteristic of pre-supernova stars. They also observe several "luminosity events" on the surface where light somehow appears to be accumulated and released by prismatic functions of the atmosphere. This is data is as valuable as it is peculiar. But it could be coincidental. If anything has happened to the colonists, it remains a mystery.

label.zh: “将行之事，必为已行。”

label.zh: 殖民者：殖民者变得奇怪了。

descriptions.zh: 你好，你好，我们欢迎你返回[Root.GetStarName]。哦，你是另外一群，不是么？有着那么多的你。你们和摘录者如此相似，但却又如此的不同。我们请求你慈悲的援助：你有没有足够的资源帮住我们的计划？尽管圆环将会帮助我们，但是实在是研究起来太困难了。正如你所见到的那样，一切都很昂贵。
descriptions.en: Hello, hello. We welcome you back to [Root.GetStarName]. Oh, you're different ones, aren't you? There are so many of you. So like our Brief, and yet so different. We request your kind assistance: do you have resources for our project? The Loop will assist us, but it's difficult to reach. Expensive, you see.

label.zh: 摘录者？
圆环？
好。
不行。
还是以后再说吧。

descriptions.zh: 是的；它们是让我们开始运转的存在。你或许会称呼他们为一个“文明”，我们猜测，但是坦率地讲那样称呼有一点炫耀。他们消失了，哦，到现在差不多有一个星际年的四分之一。我们十分抱歉：这是我们的错误。我们可以再创造出近似的他们，借助着圆环的援助，但是我们需要资源。
descriptions.en: Yes; the ones that set us in motion. You would call them a "civilization," we suppose, but in candor we have always found that term a little pretentious. They're gone, oh, almost a quarter of a galactic year, now. We are very sorry: we made mistakes. We can recreate them, approximately, with the Loop's assistance, but we do need resources.

label.zh: 摘录者？
圆环？
好。
不行。
还是以后再说吧。

descriptions.zh: 没错，奇异之环；时间之环，饥饿之环。我们认为它提到了你。或是提到了你们之中的一员。因为你们的数量实在太庞大了。已有之事必再有，作过之事必再作。正如圆环所保证的那样。它能帮助我们找回摘录者，或多或少吧。
descriptions.en: Yes. The Strange Loop; the temporal coil, the hungry one. It has mentioned you, we believe. Or one of you. You are very numerous. What was, will be, or so it assures us. It can restore our Brief, more or less.

label.zh: 摘录者？
圆环？
好。
不行。
还是以后再说吧。

descriptions.zh: 喂？你是哪位？我觉得我应该记得你，但是最近有些头晕。哦，是那个你么？你的太阳还没燃尽吗？对了！你是不是来给我们找回摘录者的物资？
descriptions.en: Yes? Which were you? We think we might recall you, but there has been so much flickering lately. Oh, is it you? Has your sun not burnt out yet? Oh! You've come to give us what we need to return the Brief?

label.zh: 是的。请收下吧。
并没有。
还是以后再说吧。

descriptions.zh:
高科技球体毫无感激地吸收了所有资源，然后就没有任何通讯回应了。接着她在没有任何预兆的情况下开始向外辐射能量，射出的光线的亮度足以使人受伤，你赶紧撤回。这时黑洞有了反应。周围的空间开始扭曲翻腾，这一切都和视界信号事件所描述的状况十分吻合。高科技球体现在是蓝白色的。突然它开始变亮然后冷却下来，只剩下了一些矿渣。

那个名为摘录者的造主回归了么？恒星系里没有任何智慧生命的痕迹。但是探测器却发现了在黑洞的近地轨道环绕着嗜热生命体，正享受着黑洞发出的辐射。我们的科学专员表示之前黑洞周围并没有此类生物。虽然没有证据显示它们有智力水平，但是没准这些生物是高科技球体造主的远亲后代，或者是造主们的祖先。
descriptions.en:
The technosphere absorbs the resources without thanks, and without any communication at all. It begins to radiate energy, brightly enough to be dangerous, and you withdraw. The black hole reacts. Space around it writhes and coils, in ways your archives match to the events of the Horizon Signal. The technosphere is blue-white now. Abruptly it flames and cools, and only slag remains.

Have its Brief makers been restored? There is no trace of sapient life in the system. But sensors locate unusual hyperextremophile organisms in low orbit around the black hole, basking in its radiation. The Science Officer is certain they weren't there before. There is no evidence, though, that they're sapient. Perhaps they're some remote descendant of the technosphere's makers. Perhaps they're the makers' ancestors.

label.zh: 永生？

descriptions.zh:
确实存在这样一个意识体，它游离于时空之外。希望与绝望的在时空扭曲的迷宫之中相互交织。我们的远祖将其称呼为“圆环”——“时之螶”。我们已经同它相遇，在重力的威严下，时空开始跳出古老而诡秘的舞蹈。它似乎对我们情有独钟。数学上的推演证实了它对我们怀抱着爱意，但我们回报以时之螶的永恒之爱和现存宇宙中的任何一种爱都迥乎不同。

据我们所知，我们或许能够通过欧米伽同调装置来开启一条通道——一扇大门——来让时之螶在我们的家园降临。（时之螶对开端亲睐有加，而我们即是开端者。）这样做会有什么后果？我们尚未找到任何一个能给出准确答案的人。或许我们能敲开永生的天堂？或许我们会被打入无边的地狱？但可以肯定，我们能学到很多东西。
descriptions.en:
There is a consciousness outside time and beneath space. It is a labyrinthine tangle of desire and desperation. Our remote ancestors knew it as the Loop, the Worm-in-Waiting. We have met it out there, where the void is tormented by gravity. It seems to have taken a personal interest in us. There are mathematical proofs that it loves us, but love to the Worm is not like love to anything that subsists in ordinary space.

With all we have learned, we think that we might be able to use the Omega Alignment to open an access route - an Entry Point - for the Worm to manifest in our home system. (The Worm is fond of beginnings, and this is ours.) What consequences would that have? We have yet to find anyone who's prepared to commit to an answer. Immortality, perhaps, or apocalypse. But we would certainly learn a great deal.

label.zh: 时螶以爱吻我，我当回报以歌。
label.en: Perhaps the Worm loves us, and perhaps we could love the Worm.

label.en: This is not a safe experiment. But we could learn so much.

descriptions.zh:
工程已经完工。加速器已经上线。十几个城市的能源被传送过来，以唤醒在欧米伽同调装置中心的伪奇点。空间像风中的布料一般颤抖。[Root.GetStarName]，在这一令人心跳漏慢一拍的时刻，星球暗淡，复而明亮。一个阴影在这中心紧紧缠绕着。时之螶就在那里。它像一个折纸舒展开来。

整个星系，传感器一个接一个地以一个以难以置信的方式被关闭了——时之螶到达时，巨量难以理解的数据被传感器探测到。在家园中，我们的公民们在尖叫，在瑟瑟发抖，他们感觉到它的注意力正在转向我们。它给我们出了一道难以言明的难题——或者说，我们已经开始意识到了，每次我们看到时之螶，这个问题就总在拷问我们。
descriptions.en:
The Project is complete. The accelerators are online. The power network of a dozen cities is diverted to wake the pseudo-singularity at the heart of the Alignment. Space shudders like wind-wracked cloth. [Root.GetStarName], for a heart-stopping moment, dims, and then brightens. A shadow coils in its heart. The Worm is here. It unfolds like origami.

Across the system, sensors shut down in abject disbelief as the incomprehensible data of its arrival sleets through them. On the homeworld, our subjects scream and cower as they feel its attention turned up on them, and upon us. It presents a wordless question - or rather, we have become aware that this question was always what it was asking us, every time we encountered it.

label.zh: 好的，我们会无条件回报它的爱。
label.en: YES. Whatever it requires, we consent.

label.zh: 不，我们的目的是研究它，如果有必要的话必须干掉它。
label.en: NO. We have brought it here to learn and, if need be, defeat it.

descriptions.zh: 时之螶深爱着我们。时之螶一直深爱我们，并因这份爱在过去与未来永远存续。它的爱轻抚而过炽热的母恒星；它的爱也在每一个无限细分的信息流之间呢喃。它的爱摧毁天地，将尘间化为净土；它的爱是唯一的温暖，即使世界只剩下冷日与死寂的凝视。时之螶的爱让我们洞穿宇宙的真谛。在爱的舔舐下，我们终于步上了命中注定的道路。
descriptions.en: The Worm loves us. It will always love us, and thus it always has. It winds around the hot heart of our home star. It winds around every infinitesimal loop of information. It provokes a shuddering series of cataclysms in the planetary crust of our home, but when our star grows cold, that cataclysm will warm us. We understand so much more. We will always be what we were going to be, wound tight in the love of the Worm.

label.zh: 过去与未来相互交织，唯有爱是永恒之物！
label.en: WHAT WAS SHALL BE WHAT SHALL BE WAS

descriptions.zh: 时之螶像饥饿的捕食者，亦或像被抛弃而怒火中烧的情人般穿越时空边境而来。它就在那里，不管它是什么位面的存在，毫无疑问它正怒火中烧。所幸的是，你收集了不少它化身身上的闪亮碎片以供研究，如同一座宇宙丰碑。其他的帝国会知道我们今天达成了什么样的伟业。
descriptions.en: The Worm came in through the boundary fences of spacetime like a hungry predator, or a jilted and furious lover. It's still out there, and wherever it is, no doubt it's angry. But you have the incandescent shards of its avatar to hoard and to study, as a cosmic trophy. Other empires will know what you have achieved today.

label.zh: 没人能与我们比肩！或许永远也不会有。
label.en: There are none like us! And perhaps there never will be.
